Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 146. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 60 ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Final Flash
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self (300 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
Two compressed energy spheres forced together into
a devestating beam attack.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 300 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw taking 12d6 Ki Damage on a
fail, half on a success.
